name: Yonggui Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yonggui Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of connectors, interconnection systems, and smart precision products in China, Europe, North America, and rest of the Asia-Pacific. It offers new energy and vehicle components, such as EV, charging, energy storage, telecom, and fluid connector; railway and industrial system components, such as connector, electric coupler, gangway, axle counter, pantograph, battery module, and door system; special connectors, including explosion-proof, deep sea, nuclear, optical fiber, and RF connector; and wire harness, injection molding, and railway ecosystem.
